description: This header provides debugging APIs for hash table probing behavior, including functions to get probe counts, histograms, summaries, and memory usage related to hash tables in the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugNumProbes
methods.description: Returns the number of probes required to lookup a key in a hash table, indicating collision levels.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugNumProbesHistogram
methods.description: Generates a histogram of probe counts for all elements in a container.

methods.name: GetHashtableDebugProbeSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary including total elements, total probes, and average probes per element.

methods.name: AllocatedByteSize
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes allocated for the container's hash table.

methods.name: LowerBoundAllocatedByteSize
methods.description: Provides a lower bound estimate of memory allocation for a given number of elements.
